demonstrations.hierarchical_sequence_mode: complete episodes; recurrent state carried over the full sequence

protocol.task: three-chef SharedKitchen at the standard stage; final evaluation uses the shared HiPT actor for all three chefs
protocol.behavior_cloning: population actors use observation batches; the hierarchical actor uses complete episode sequences with LSTM state carried through time before its PPO optimizer is constructed; one dataset transition budget is counted once
protocol.hierarchical_behavior_cloning: full-length episode unrolls, two episodes/six chef streams per batch; low-level teacher actions supervise every z head, while the unsupervised high-level z head is left for RL
protocol.population: Three paper skill levels are retained: randomly initialized policies as low-skill partners, saved snapshots nearest half each final team score, and fully trained policies. Behavior cloning initializes the active learner population but does not replace the frozen random initial snapshot.
protocol.skill_levels: The partner population uses random initialization, approximately half-final-score historical policies, and fully trained policies, following arXiv:2305.16708 section 4.1.
protocol.hierarchical: shared current HiPT actor; 50% self-play and otherwise two current actors plus one fixed historical population actor; fixed partner role rotates over episodes; all three roles are training targets
protocol.macro_reward: option reward is the observed-duration average of environment reward plus influence_coef * KL(current low policy || high-weighted all-z action mixture); high GAE gamma/lambda are per completed option as in the paper
protocol.recurrent_training: low PPO replays the rollout sequence with detached initial LSTM state; high PPO delays each transition until natural option expiry or true terminal and replays up to one rollout of episode context with gradients through the LSTM
protocol.optimization: low and high PPO objectives are summed before each shared-parameter optimizer step; both entropy coefficients start at 0.01 and decay linearly over the hierarchical budget
protocol.pool_selection: the low-skill partner is the randomly initialized pre-BC snapshot; each mid partner is the saved 250k-step snapshot nearest half its final standard team_score; the high-skill partner is the fully trained final policy. Nonpositive final team scores are qualityfailed and are not claimed high-skill
protocol.best_checkpoint_ties: latest evaluated checkpoint wins equal team_score ties
protocol.rollout_boundary: an unfinished option keeps its z and timer across rollout updates; it is not shortened or resampled; its original log-probability/value and reward accumulator are retained, so the high PPO ratio may span low-policy updates and is clipped
protocol.evaluation: all three chefs use the learned hierarchical policy in standard, unshaped SharedKitchen; no population partners are used
protocol.step_accounting: one vector environment transition counts once, including the demonstration dataset's declared environment steps; actor count and chef slots do not multiply this budget; evaluation wall time counts toward max-seconds

pool_selection.target: final team_score / 2, including negative final scores

members.quality_warning: final team_score <= 0; retain selected weights without claiming high skill
